name: isa-gate
description: ISA gate, Q1: is this prompt work that needs an ISA? (FOUNDATION_1: asked of every prompt with no open ISA or spec bound)

work.instructions: Does this message ask for work with several dependent steps, where a mistake in one step could carry into the final result unnoticed unless each step is checked — as opposed to a quick exchange, or a 1–3 step action whose failure would be immediate and evident? Yes: a feature, a change across several places, a fix whose cause must be found first, a refactor, a review or audit with findings, a written plan, spec or report, a migration or a deployment whose result can break while every command succeeds; running a skill whose description is one of these. No: a question, an explanation, a lookup, showing what a file or a command contains, a discussion, small talk; a 1–3 step action whose failure the tool reports at once (commit, push, run the tests, install, rename one thing); the user asking to work without an ISA. A short reply ("go", "yes do it") counts as whatever it approves in the assistant's previous message.
